name: folio-react
description: React print / PDF toolkit: browser print, PDF export, preview, RTL, configurable pages, and printable document building blocks.

scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist/styles && cp src/styles/tokens.css dist/styles/tokens.css && cp src/styles/printTemplate.css dist/styles/printTemplate.css && cp src/styles/tablePrint.css dist/styles/tablePrint.css && cp src/styles/printPreview.css dist/styles/printPreview.css && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['tokens.css','printTemplate.css','tablePrint.css','printPreview.css']; const out=files.map(f=>fs.readFileSync('src/styles/'+f,'utf8').replace(/@import[^;]+;/g,'')).join('\n'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/styles/index.css', out);"
scripts.build:js: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --external react --external react-dom --external react-to-print --external html2canvas --external jspdf
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
